Results.ReviewText: I'm a 70-year old retiree, relocated two (2) years ago to older, historic district, residential neighborhood in New Orleans with wife--we're "empty nesters". I shopped & researched extensively for best grill. I previously had large ceramic grill & Weber charcoal grills, but I purchased a gas grill for ease of cooking & clean-up. My Spirit II E-210 gas grill was easy to assemble. Prior to assembly I recommend you carefully inventory all parts, then do a read-through of the instructions, &,THEN, assemble your grill--closely following the instructions step-by-step. I've had grill close to one (1) month now, & I'm still getting to know its idiosynchracies. However, so far this grill heats quickly & evenly & cooks extremely well--it has a fairly small footprint but has a large enough cooking surface & heating capacity for preparation of the meats & vegetables for four (4) to six (6) people. I can honestly say for its workmanship, quality, convenience, & ease of operation & cooking--it's the best grill I've ever owned! Thank you Weber

Results.ReviewText:
I really like the grill.  Heats-up quickly, cooks well!

I have one design improvement suggestion.  The tray that folds down is the tray by which you pull/push the grill around.  If you go over a bumpy surface it tends to 'flop' down and you lose control.   I understand that you cannot not switch the placement of the folding and stationary trays because the stationary tray is over the wheels and tank and there is no room for it to fold down.  I suggest you make the folding tray 'lockable' - perhaps with some sort of a clip/lock nut.  I never fold the tray anyway so for me is is a 'feature' that is of no interest and a bit of a nuisance when I move the grill - which I do every time I cook.  Perhaps others feel the same way?

Otherwise, the grill is great!
Results.Title: A Design Improvement Suggestion

Results.ReviewText:
After looking at every type of grill in this size category (Char-Broil, Kitchen-Aid, and the off brands) I decided to pony up the money and go for what my gut said and we are all so glad I did. The grill cooks pretty evening throughout and the time suggestions on the “Grilling Guide” are spot on. We’ve done burgers, steaks, chicken, fish, veggies...you name it. All delicious, juicy, and flavorful. My grill does have a hot spot in the back left corner but once you learn where it is, it’s like your oven in the kitchen—you learn to adapt. The best part of the grill?? The community you develop in your backyard because your family, friends, & neighbors all love your grill too and are always down for a cookout! 

You really can’t go wrong. Solid grill. Even cooking. Flavorful foods. Easy cleanup. All backed with Weber’s 10yr warranty and proudly made in the USA.
